name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace
typeText: {α : Type u_5} → [self : NonUnitalSeminormedRing.{u_5} α] → PseudoMetricSpace.{u_5} α

source.code:
class NonUnitalSeminormedRing (α : Type*) extends Norm α, NonUnitalRing α,
  PseudoMetricSpace α where
  /-- The distance is induced by the norm. -/
  dist_eq : ∀ x y, dist x y = norm (x - y)
  /-- The norm is submultiplicative. -/
  protected norm_mul_le : ∀ a b, norm (a * b) ≤ norm a * norm b
